Title: Gradient Descent and Cost Functions
Summary: The video introduces gradient descent as a method to minimize a cost function by iteratively adjusting weights in the direction of the negative gradient. It explains how each component of the gradient indicates the direction and relative importance of changes to input variables, with magnitudes reflecting their impact on the cost. This foundational concept is illustrated using a 2D function before extending to high-dimensional spaces relevant to neural networks.
